Class MenuCharacterOptions

java.lang.Object
org.app.consoleMenu.characterMenu.MenuCharacterOptions
public class MenuCharacterOptions extends Object
The MenuCharacterOptions class provides the logic for handling character-related operations such as listing all characters, adding a new character, or querying characters by their house or character key.

This class interacts with the CharacterService to manage characters and HouseService to fetch houses for associating characters with their respective houses.

  • Method Details

    • listAllCharacters

      public void listAllCharacters()
      Lists all characters stored in the database by fetching them from the CharacterService. Displays the characters in the console, or notifies the user if no characters are found.

    • addNewCharacter

      public void addNewCharacter(Scanner scanner)
      Adds a new character to the database. The user is prompted to input the character's key, name, birthplace, weapon, skill level, and the house key to associate the character with a house. If the house key is invalid, the character is not added.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.

    • queryCharactersByHouseKey

      public void queryCharactersByHouseKey(Scanner scanner)
      Queries and displays all characters associated with a specific house key. The user is prompted to enter the house key, and the characters associated with the house are displayed.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.

    • queryCharacterByKey

      public void queryCharacterByKey(Scanner scanner)
      Queries and displays a character by their unique character key. The user is prompted to enter the character key, and the corresponding character is displayed if found.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.
